title: Compact-tier market seeding: Ireland & UK dedicated capacity playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: deliver a concise playbook for seeding 'compact-tier' dedicated capacity in Ireland (eu-west-1) and the UK (eu-west-2). Scope covers SKU publication, pricing validation, console telemetry, cross-team readiness (SRE, Billing, Sales, Legal), and a gated soft-launch with 2-week ramp. Deliverables: 1) published pricing and reservation options, 2) runbook and rollback plan, 3) console dashboards with per-SKU metrics, 4) sales enablement + migration worksheet, 5) post-launch operational checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity: compact-tier instances (g4-small equivalent) available and healthy in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2
Billing: price table published and validated in billing pipeline; sample invoices match expected lines
Console: SKU appears in Dedicated UI with allocation, SLOs, and cost-per-token estimates
Runbook: tabletop-tested runbook with SRE and Support; rollback steps documented
Sales: one-pager and migration worksheet available; channels trained via recorded session

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: kernel/instance-family incompatibility could increase latency in first week. Mitigation: soft-launch on smaller subset (10% traffic) and enable fallback to flex pool.
Risk: billing misclassification for reservation purchases. Mitigation: block public purchase until ENG-35802 mapping fix and run end-to-end invoice test for 3 sample accounts.
Risk: sales overpromising hardware availability. Mitigation: publish explicit region-level capacity buckets and automated stock indicator in the console.
Risk: regulatory/cert timing in UK. Mitigation: Legal confirmed existing certifications sufficient; include compliance note in release notes.
launch_plan: Week -3: Engineering pre-warm and enable burst pool; Billing completes SKU mapping QA; Docs writes API examples
Week -2: Sales enablement session + recorded demo; Support tabletop run; Create escalation rota
Week -1: Soft-launch to internal and partner customers (invite-only); monitor telemetry; check billing flows
Launch day: Open to public with 2-hour ramp windows and circuit-breaker thresholds; announce in status and product channels
Post-launch (2 weeks): Monitor SLOs, collect customer feedback, schedule g6x family rollout as patch if kernel issues resolved
